elements.name: Tomo D1
elements.notes: On the panel Tomo D1 is drawn above the beam line and NF D2 below it (both beside the Aero SMS), so they look like alternative detectors moved into the beam rather than in series (inferred, user to confirm). In p04 the stage left of the sample carries a camera box on tags E40 / E38 / E62, which match tomoEus y (m40), rz (m38), z (m62), so tomoEus is probably this stage. Which of the profile cameras gh1 / pg1 is on it is NOT established (gh1 = high-res table, pg1 = back wall per earlier notes).

elements.name: NF D2
elements.notes: Near-field detector. Retractable placement inferred from the panel layout (see tomoE).

elements.name: Hydra D4
elements.notes: Far-field detector (Hydra); CAM-9 tag below it on the panel.

elements.name: Radiograph
